rationale: Operator 2026-10-14 via rubric. repoRoot is never read as a path: policy, prefix and task file already come from the GitHub contents API at main's resolved SHA, so the CLI-repo anchor guards a disk read that no longer exists (five-step: delete). Trust root becomes the server-side main of the repo the PR is in; the slug is derived from the cwd work tree's origin via gh repo view. Rejected verified-fetch: local origin/main refs are agent-writable, weaker than the API read. Rejected keep-cli-anchor: adopters on the plugin cache cannot land PRs, blocks ai-sdlc-io DEC-0008. Rejected explicit --repo: loses the cwd-origin sanity check for no adopter gain today; can be added later as opt-in. Counter-argument (fork with lenient policy) rebutted: merging into a repo you already control is not an escalation. Reversal: restore the anchor half of resolveTrustedMainRoot.
